$comment: Depth-3 reviewer: never prompts a human, never edits code; posts its own round via gh api (reviews, comments). Agent = the pr-review-toolkit fan-out and, in a validate round, the Chrome walkers; mcp__claude-in-chrome__* = the walk's browser tools, listed one by one (anything else from that server stays denied); Workflow = deep mode on the operator's opt-in only. Launched with --permission-mode dontAsk; anything not allowed is denied and reported to the PM. Writes only its findings file and a validate round's screenshots under {state_dir}/reviews/ (launch.sh fills in the real state dir). A screenshot is copied in with cat <shot> > <dest> (a cp source must sit in a working dir); the Read allow covers only the browser tool's claude-chrome-screenshots-* folder. Never writes a story: acceptance criteria are ticked by the validator (the operator's stories) or the author (a teammate's). open-tab.sh appends the project's validation commands. Path rules for writes are Edit(...) (they cover Write); a bare Edit deny would block the findings file too — dontAsk already denies every edit not allowed. A hold is the one PR write outside its round: gh pr edit --add-label HUMAN_NEEDED and one gh pr comment --body-file (every other edit/comment form denied). A test-discrimination check builds a disposable pre-change tree only under {state_dir}/reviews/scratch/<pr> (add, checkout, node_modules link, remove); a '..' in a scratch path is denied. The PM-made review worktree ({workspace}/.worktrees/review-<pr>) is re-pinned to a moved head only by checkout --detach; a '..' in its path is denied.
